reference_sql:
SELECT country_code,
       SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'web' THEN net_revenue_eur END)
         / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN channel = 'web' THEN order_id END) AS web_order_value_eur,
       SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'store' THEN net_revenue_eur END)
         / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN channel = 'store' THEN order_id END) AS store_order_value_eur
FROM sales
WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY country_code
alternatives: SELECT country_code, SUM(net_revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'web') / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'web') AS web_order_value_eur, SUM(net_revenue_eur) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'store') / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FILTER (WHERE channel = 'store') AS store_order_value_eur FROM sales WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY country_code

SELECT country_code, SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'web' THEN net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN channel = 'web' THEN order_id END) AS web_order_value_eur, SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'store' THEN net_revenue_eur ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN channel = 'store' THEN order_id END) AS store_order_value_eur FROM sales WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1
